title: tk herd spawn: worktree + agent start + gated first prompt
description: cmd/tk/cmd/herd_spawn.go + internal/herd/state (run-state manifest) + spawn logic in internal/herd. tk herd spawn <tick-id> [--role NAME] [--tier NAME] [--config PATH] [--json]: load tick via the internal tick store (title/description/acceptance/epic), resolve kind+model/effort/args via internal/herd/config (refusals propagate), then per skills/ticks/references/herdr-runner.md: worktree.create (branch <worktree_branch_prefix><tick-id>, --base current integration HEAD, no-focus), agent.start with compiled argv, the first-round-trip content gate exactly as documented (trivial prompt, read pane content, distinguish silent-drop -> re-send once vs error content -> fail with pane excerpt), then submit the real implementer prompt built from the tick body per the worker template in herdr-runner.md (RESULT-<tick-id>.md contract, no tk / no .tick/ boundary). Write a run-state manifest entry under .tick/logs/herd/<epic>/<tick>.json (internal/herd/state owns the format: tick, branch, worktree path, workspace id, pane id, agent name, kind, model/effort, agent_session when captured post-gate, spawn commit) and print the runner-state note line for the orchestrator to tk note. The command itself never runs tk note (orchestrator owns tracker writes). Cobra + legacy switch registration + ResetFlags as per learnings. Unit tests via fake socket server: happy path, gate silent-drop retry, gate error content, compatibility refusal, manifest written atomically.
notes: 2026-08-11 15:13 - runner-state: runner=claude branch=worktree-agent-a1614b9a8deee5046 substrate=harness. Concern resolved: non-blocking dispatch default ACCEPTED — blocking would serialize waves and duplicate tk herd wait; tick text was imprecise, implementation matches epic intent.
acceptance_criteria: go test -short -count=1 ./... passes; spawn is a single command producing worktree+gated worker+manifest+note line on the fake server; refusal and gate-failure paths tested
closed_reason: Completed: tk herd spawn — compile via config, worktree+agent via client, three-outcome content gate (echo-anchored search closes the probe-contains-answer hole), post-gate session capture, atomic manifest + note line; non-blocking dispatch default (wait is the fan-in)
